decisions.reason: Applying help labels to all control fields does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The source expands the scope of help labels, not the existence, type, or behavior of the checklist control.
The source expands the scope of help labels without changing the dropdown control's type, document, or behavior.
Help-label coverage is independent of the unresolved mechanism for visually identifying fillable fields.
Adding help labels across control fields does not change placeholder clearing or field-activation behavior.
The help-label scope decision does not alter the required robust placeholder mechanism.
The decision may cause the separate help-label requirement to apply to a date control, but it does not change the date selector's input method or scope.
The source concerns interactive-field help-label coverage and does not affect the master template's theme colors.
The help-label scope decision does not change automatic list continuation when Enter is pressed.
